title: Cars, delivered to the villa
lede: The island is small, but the best coves are down lanes a taxi will not take. We arrange cars from local operators — delivered, insured and ready when you land.
image_alt: A villa garden and drive in Ibiza

sections.title: The right car for the right week
paragraphs: A small car is perfect for two and for the lanes around Santa Gertrudis. A family of five will want an SUV, and a group of eight will need something larger — or two cars, which is often easier and cheaper.

We arrange delivery to your villa or the airport, full insurance, additional drivers and child seats. For evenings out, we can also arrange a driver, so nobody has to think about parking in Ibiza Town.

items.title: Compact
items.text: Easy to park, easy on fuel, ideal for two and the north's narrow lanes.

items.title: SUV
items.text: Room for the family, the beach kit and the shopping. The most popular choice.

items.title: Premium & convertible
items.text: For the drive to dinner, or the coast road at sunset.

items.title: Seven seats & vans
items.text: For larger groups, airport runs and everything that comes with a villa.

items.title: Drivers
items.text: English-speaking drivers by the hour or the evening, with a car included.

items.title: Transfers
items.text: Airport transfers timed to your flight, with a name at arrivals.

sections.title: What we sort out
items: Delivery to your villa, the airport or the marina
Additional drivers at no extra charge
An English-speaking contact on the island if anything goes wrong

sections.title: Tell us when you land
sections.text: Send your dates, the number of drivers and the size of your group. We will send options and prices.
